message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate charge(s) for the case.

Facts: In July 2014, defendant Tan (谭某某) hired temporary workers including victim Li to make an advertising board at a company's location. Tan had no construction qualification, did not require safety helmets or safety ropes. During construction, Li fell from scaffolding, suffered head injury, died. Safety supervision authority identified Tan as the person with primary responsibility (new bridge advertising engineering department head). Tan was arrested, confessed, and after settlement paid compensation.

Thus this is a serious accident with liability due to failure to follow safety regulations, leading to death. In examples, similar cases (construction accidents) were labeled "重大责任事故". Indeed first examples: Zhejiang case, etc. So charge: 重大责任事故.

Check if any other charges like "玩忽职守" (neglect of duty) or "过失致人死亡". But the instruction says "重大责任事故" describes a serious accident with liability, not a criminal charge like "过失致人死亡". In training examples, they used "重大责任事故" for similar construction accidents. So answer: [罪名]重大责任事故<eoa>.
